title: tc-checkbox
description: A yes / no choice saved with a form – label and second line, a partly-checked state, a card row and an error line.

indeterminate.description: Partly checked: a dash for a Select all over a list that's only partly picked; clicking it checks it

variant.description: "default" (a box and its label) or "card" (a bordered row, clickable anywhere)

errorMessage.description: An error shown under the checkbox, e.g. "Accept the terms to go on"; empty shows none

value.description: Current value; prevent tc-value-change to control it from the application.

name.description: Form field name; objects and arrays are serialized as JSON.

disabled.description: Disable editing and omit the control from form submission.
